specificFindings: Narrator visit to UC Riverside and professorship at UVA are distinct and qualified at the time; driver and author family/job roles are not exchanged.
Carried grandchildren is clarified by the account of gestational carrier, not taxi transport; surprise does not independently prove or disprove the story.
Was hearing is ongoing listening in the past, not a medical-file verification; medical case details remain a reported personal account without general safety or success claims.
Almost crying preserves degree. Each grandchild in the birth/feeding account is interpreted with the two she carried, not all seven.
Kidney recipient is ex-husband, not current husband or son-in-law; her moral account is not converted to a rule for everyone.
Twins and age18 before meeting her husband refer to two of her own four children, not two grandchildren; both fragment targets cite the complete printed sentence.
Travel timeline retains France3months recently and SoutheastAsia2months collectively the previous year, not two months per country or relative to today.
Sing praises is idiomatic. What an interesting life and I think fair to say are narrator evaluations, not Linda direct self-quotation or objective personality measurements.
Contribute to means play a part in producing, not only financial contribution, complete identity or reversed causation.
Two September2015 focus groups are not a nationwide representative poll or randomised clinical trials. Weekend recall precedes the happiness question.
Happiest, most meaningful and most psychologically rich questions remain distinct and in sequence; helping/service/volunteering examples support the meaningful dimension.
Memorable means standing out to the narrator, not representative, unanimously happy or identical.
Grace sophomore/suburbanDC/first wrestling with friends is distinguished from Rachel sophomore/centralVirginia/apartment lounge.
Grace mixed joy and pain ends in being moved; moved is emotional not physical movement, and complexity is not reduced to only pleasure.
All13 unique inherited English/Chinese parent pairs were read; ages, generations, voice, sequence, research design and geographical assignments checked.
